contract.application_relevance: Workers return 204 acknowledgments and construct bodyless POST operations.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: Absent bodies have no stream and cannot become disturbed; conversions yield empty values.
contract.distinctness: Presence/absence representation, not a nonempty body replay or malformed use.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.equal(response.body, null, 'null Response has no stream');
t.equal(await t.consume(response, 'text'), '', 'consuming absent body yields empty text');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'absent body cannot become disturbed');
t.equal((await t.consume(response, 'arrayBuffer')).byteLength, 0, 'null body remains available as empty bytes');
t.equal(response.bodyUsed, false, 'second null-body conversion still has no disturbed stream');
t.equal(request.body, null, 'POST with no BodyInit has absent rather than empty-stream body');
contract.hypothesis: Body consumers may set a boolean used flag even with no stream, or a bodyless POST may be represented as an empty stream.
contract.mechanism: Null Body representation and bodyUsed semantics
preconditions: Reviewed exact direct-celld source/build/deployment pins and fresh isolated local store.
Native celld Blob, File, FormData, Request, Response, and ReadableStream globals; no mocks or implementation extraction.
External five-second case deadline plus independent 300-second suite deadline and owned cleanup are active.

schedule.parallelism: two local body consumers joined with allSettled only in Y220; otherwise sequential

contract.source_observation: Pinned consumers assign bodyUsed=true unconditionally; Request creates a CelldBodyStream for POST even without body. Static discrepancy hypothesis only.
